mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_room ( user_id, applicant_type, company_name, job_id, difficulty, ai_interviewer_cnt, ai_applicant_cnt, resume_id, resume_text, portfolio_id, portfolio_text, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{applicantType}, #{companyName}, #{jobId}, #{difficulty}, #{aiInterviewerCnt}, #{aiApplicantCnt}, #{resumeId}, #{resumeText}, #{portfolioId}, #{portfolioText}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT ir.room_id, ir.user_id, ir.applicant_type, ir.company_name, ir.job_id, cj.job_name, ir.difficulty, ir.ai_interviewer_cnt, ir.ai_applicant_cnt, ir.resume_id, ir.resume_text, ir.portfolio_id, ir.portfolio_text, ir.status, ir.started_at, ir.ended_at FROM interview_room ir LEFT JOIN category_job cj ON ir.job_id = cj.job_id WHERE ir.room_id = #{roomId}
